summary: The Perps tab gains a wrapping Products chip section below the Watchlist; the market list keeps one filter row that measures its overflow into a More menu, marking that trigger when the selection lives inside it; and the Sort by modal carries the direction on the selected field. Captured on Hyperliquid mainnet at branch head 7dc2aaf2fd.

standalone.label: Perps tab: the Products section sits below the Watchlist, chips wrapped with every category visible
A Products chip opens the market list already narrowed to that category, the pill pressed and clearable
Popup width: the categories that do not fit move into a More menu
A category chosen from More: the trigger is highlighted to show it holds the filter
Full width: every category fits on the row and no More trigger is rendered
Sort by modal: one list, with the selected field carrying High to low inline
